notes: The margins *the signs of the Zodiac* and the literal *sons* were read and set aside (rule 38).
One `הֲ` governs both questions and the ASV rewrites its auxiliary, so both *Canst*/*canst* belong to that morpheme's discontinuous unit, headed on the first (rule 25).
The object suffix of `תַנְחֵם` resumes `עַיִשׁ עַל־בָּנֶיהָ`, which the ASV renders once as the English object, so the suffix is the unrendered occurrence (rule 22).
